levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Misses checklist items or packs unnecessary extras without reason.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Packs against the checklist accurately with reasons for any exclusions.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Packs accurately and independently double-checks the list before finishing.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Bag fully unpacked with items returned to their homes.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Bag fully unpacked and the learner catches an easy-to-forget item on their own.

lookFors: Checklist is actually consulted during packing, not just afterward.
Unpacking happens within a reasonable time of the bag's purpose ending.
Reflection names one specific reason a habit is harder, not just "I forget."

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
